= BITwiki Integration Guide: Connecting External Systems =

== Executive Summary

This guide documents methods for integrating BITwiki with external systems including content management systems, research databases, analytics platforms, and knowledge graphs.

'''Scope:''' API access, webhook configuration, data export/import, authentication, rate limiting.

----
== 1. Integration Architecture

=== 1.1 Integration Patterns

| Pattern | Use Case | Protocol |
|---------|----------|----------|
| '''Read API''' | Query BITwiki content | HTTP GET + JSON |
| '''Write API''' | Create/update content | HTTP POST/PUT + OAuth |
| '''Webhook''' | Real-time notifications | HTTP POST + JSON |
| '''Export''' | Bulk data transfer | RDF/JSON/XML |
| '''Import''' | External data ingestion | SMW + API |
| '''Federation''' | Cross-wiki queries | SPARQL |

=== 1.2 Security Model

'''Authentication:'''
* OAuth 2.0 for user-delegated access
* API keys for system-to-system
* IP whitelisting for trusted partners

'''Authorization:'''
* Role-based access control (RBAC)
* Scope-limited tokens
* Audit logging for all access

'''Data Protection:'''
* TLS 1.3 for all connections
* Epistemic markers preserved in transit
* Provenance tracking for imported data

----
== 2. API Reference

=== 2.1 MediaWiki API

'''Base URL:''' `https://bitwiki.org/api.php`

'''Query Content:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=query&titles=BITwiki_Constitution&prop=revisions&rvslots=main&rvprop=content&format=json"
```

'''Search with SMW:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Has%20entity%20type::Concept]]&format=json"
```

'''Create Page (Authenticated):'''
```bash
curl -X POST "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=edit&title=New_Page&text=Content&token=TOKEN&format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY"
```

=== 2.2 SMW API

'''Ask Query:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Has%20confidence::>0.8]]|?Has%20title|?Has%20epistemic%20status&format=json"
```

'''Browse Properties:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=browsebysubject&subject=BITwiki_Constitution&format=json"
```

'''Export RDF:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/index.php?title=Special:ExportRDF/BITwiki_Constitution"
```

=== 2.3 Response Format

'''Success Response:'''
```json
{
  "query": {
    "results": {
      "BITwiki_Constitution": {
        "printouts": {
          "Has title": ["BITwiki Constitution"],
          "Has epistemic status": ["Axiomatic"],
          "Has confidence": ["1.0"]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

'''Error Response:'''
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalidtitle",
    "info": "Bad title \"Invalid|Title\"."
  }
}
```

----
== 3. Webhook Configuration

=== 3.1 Event Types

| Event | Trigger | Payload |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `page.created` | New page | Page title, author, timestamp |
| `page.edited` | Edit saved | Diff, author, epistemic change |
| `page.deleted` | Page removed | Title, deleter, reason |
| `epistemic.upgraded` | Status increased | Old/new status, confidence |
| `epistemic.downgraded` | Status decreased | Old/new status, reason |
| `quality.reviewed` | Audit complete | Score, issues, recommendations |

=== 3.2 Webhook Endpoint

'''Configuration:'''
```php
// LocalSettings.php
$wgBITwikiWebhooks = [
  'https://external-system.com/webhook/bitwiki' => [
    'events' => ['page.edited', 'epistemic.upgraded'],
    'secret' => 'webhook_secret_key',
    'active' => true
  ]
];
```

'''Payload Structure:'''
```json
{
  "event": "epistemic.upgraded",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-13T10:30:00Z",
  "page": {
    "title": "BITwiki_Constitution",
    "url": "https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Constitution"
  },
  "changes": {
    "old_status": "Emerging",
    "new_status": "Established",
    "old_confidence": 0.75,
    "new_confidence": 0.88
  },
  "author": {
    "username": "Hyperion",
    "id": 42
  }
}
```

=== 3.3 Signature Verification

```python
import hmac
import hashlib

def verify_webhook(payload, signature, secret):
    expected = hmac.new(
        secret.encode(),
        payload.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(f"sha256={expected}", signature)
```

----
== 4. Data Exchange

=== 4.1 Export Formats

'''RDF/Turtle:'''
```turtle
@prefix bit: <https://bitwiki.org/ontology/> .
@prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

<https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Constitution>
  a bit:Concept ;
  dc:title "BITwiki Constitution" ;
  bit:hasEpistemicStatus "Axiomatic" ;
  bit:hasConfidence "1.0"^^xsd:float ;
  bit:hasAuthor "Hyperion" .
```

'''JSON-LD:'''
```json
{
  "@context": {
    "bit": "https://bitwiki.org/ontology/",
    "dc": "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
  },
  "@id": "https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Constitution",
  "@type": "bit:Concept",
  "dc:title": "BITwiki Constitution",
  "bit:hasEpistemicStatus": "Axiomatic",
  "bit:hasConfidence": 1.0
}
```

'''CSV Export:'''
```csv
Title,Entity Type,Epistemic Status,Confidence,Author
BITwiki Constitution,Concept,Axiomatic,1.0,Hyperion
SMW Template System,Technical Guide,Established,0.88,Hyperion
```

=== 4.2 Import Protocol

'''Step 1: Data Validation'''
* Check required fields (title, entity type, epistemic status)
* Validate confidence range (0.0-1.0)
* Verify source provenance

'''Step 2: Epistemic Marking'''
* Imported data defaults to "Hypothetical" status
* Confidence set to 0.5 (neutral)
* Provenance tracked as import source

'''Step 3: Deduplication'''
* Check for existing entities with same title
* Merge or create new as appropriate
* Preserve both provenance chains

'''Step 4: SMW Import'''
```bash
php maintenance/importDump.php import.xml
```

----
== 5. Authentication

=== 5.1 OAuth 2.0 Flow

'''Step 1: Authorization Request'''
```
https://bitwiki.org/oauth/authorize?
  response_type=code&
  client_id=CLIENT_ID&
  redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI&
  scope=read+write&
  state=STATE
```

'''Step 2: Token Exchange'''
```bash
curl -X POST "https://bitwiki.org/oauth/token" \
  -d "grant_type=authorization_code" \
  -d "code=AUTH_CODE" \
  -d "client_id=CLIENT_ID" \
  -d "client_secret=CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d "redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI"
```

'''Step 3: API Access'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=query&..." \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN"
```

=== 5.2 API Key Management

'''Generate Key:'''
```php
// Special:ApiKeyManager
$apiKey = hash('sha256', random_bytes(32));
```

'''Rate Limits:'''

| Tier | Requests/Minute | Use Case |
|------|-----------------|----------|
| Public | 60 | Unauthenticated read |
| Basic | 300 | API key authentication |
| Premium | 1000 | Verified applications |
| BITCORE | Unlimited | Internal systems |

----
== 6. Integration Examples

=== 6.1 Research Database Integration

'''Scenario:''' Import publications from academic database

```python
import requests

# Fetch from external API
response = requests.get('https://api.semanticscholar.org/...')
papers = response.json()

# Transform to BITwiki format
for paper in papers:
    bitwiki_page = {
        'title': paper['title'],
        'entity_type': 'Source',
        'epistemic_status': 'Established',
        'confidence': paper['citation_count'] / 1000,  # Normalized
        'has_doi': paper['doi'],
        'has_author': paper['authors']
    }
    
    # Create via BITwiki API
    requests.post(
        'https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=edit',
        data=bitwiki_page,
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN'}
    )
```

=== 6.2 Analytics Dashboard

'''Scenario:''' Real-time knowledge graph metrics

```javascript
// Fetch epistemic distribution
async function updateDashboard() {
  const response = await fetch(
    'https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Has%20epistemic%20status::+]]|?Has%20epistemic%20status&format=json'
  );
  const data = await response.json();
  
  // Update chart
  const distribution = countByStatus(data.query.results);
  chart.update(distribution);
}
```

=== 6.3 Slack Notifications

'''Scenario:''' Alert on epistemic status changes

```python
import requests

def webhook_handler(payload):
    if payload['event'] == 'epistemic.upgraded':
        message = f"""
        📈 Epistemic Upgrade: {payload['page']['title']}
        {payload['changes']['old_status']} → {payload['changes']['new_status']}
        Confidence: {payload['changes']['old_confidence']} → {payload['changes']['new_confidence']}
        """
        
        requests.post('https://hooks.slack.com/...', json={
            'text': message
        })
```

----
== 7. Error Handling

=== 7.1 Common Errors

| Error Code | Cause | Resolution |
|------------|-------|------------|
| `invalidtitle` | Illegal characters in title | Sanitize input |
| `missingparam` | Required parameter absent | Check API docs |
| `ratelimited` | Too many requests | Implement backoff |
| `permissiondenied` | Insufficient privileges | Check OAuth scopes |
| `epistemicviolation` | Invalid status transition | Review status rules |

=== 7.2 Retry Logic

```python
import time
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from requests.packages.urllib3.util.retry import Retry

retry_strategy = Retry(
    total=3,
    backoff_factor=1,
    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
)

session = requests.Session()
session.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy))
```

----
== 8. Best Practices

=== 8.1 Performance
* Cache API responses (respect Cache-Control headers)
* Use batch operations for bulk updates
* Request only needed properties
* Implement client-side rate limiting

=== 8.2 Reliability
* Handle network timeouts gracefully
* Implement exponential backoff
* Log all API interactions
* Monitor webhook delivery

=== 8.3 Security
* Never commit API keys to version control
* Rotate keys regularly
* Use minimal required scopes
* Validate webhook signatures

----
== Conclusion

BITwiki's integration capabilities enable it to function as a hub in the broader knowledge ecosystem. By supporting standard protocols and maintaining epistemic integrity across boundaries, BITwiki extends its recursive knowledge architecture to external systems.

'''Key Principles:'''
* Preserve epistemic markers in all exchanges
* Maintain provenance chains across systems
* Support bidirectional data flow
* Implement robust error handling

'''Next Steps:'''
# Deploy OAuth server
# Configure webhook endpoints
# Implement RDF export
# Create integration SDKs

= BITwiki Integration Guide: Connecting External Systems =

== Executive Summary

This guide documents methods for integrating BITwiki with external systems including content management systems, research databases, analytics platforms, and knowledge graphs.

'''Scope:''' API access, webhook configuration, data export/import, authentication, rate limiting.

----
== 1. Integration Architecture

=== 1.1 Integration Patterns

| Pattern | Use Case | Protocol |
|---------|----------|----------|
| '''Read API''' | Query BITwiki content | HTTP GET + JSON |
| '''Write API''' | Create/update content | HTTP POST/PUT + OAuth |
| '''Webhook''' | Real-time notifications | HTTP POST + JSON |
| '''Export''' | Bulk data transfer | RDF/JSON/XML |
| '''Import''' | External data ingestion | SMW + API |
| '''Federation''' | Cross-wiki queries | SPARQL |

=== 1.2 Security Model

'''Authentication:'''
* OAuth 2.0 for user-delegated access
* API keys for system-to-system
* IP whitelisting for trusted partners

'''Authorization:'''
* Role-based access control (RBAC)
* Scope-limited tokens
* Audit logging for all access

'''Data Protection:'''
* TLS 1.3 for all connections
* Epistemic markers preserved in transit
* Provenance tracking for imported data

== 2. API Reference

=== 2.1 MediaWiki API

'''Base URL:''' `https://bitwiki.org/api.php`

'''Query Content:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=query&titles=BITwiki_Constitution&prop=revisions&rvslots=main&rvprop=content&format=json"
```

'''Search with SMW:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Has%20entity%20type::Concept]]&format=json"
```

'''Create Page (Authenticated):'''
```bash
curl -X POST "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=edit&title=New_Page&text=Content&token=TOKEN&format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY"
```

=== 2.2 SMW API

'''Ask Query:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Has%20confidence::>0.8]]|?Has%20title|?Has%20epistemic%20status&format=json"
```

'''Browse Properties:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=browsebysubject&subject=BITwiki_Constitution&format=json"
```

'''Export RDF:'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/index.php?title=Special:ExportRDF/BITwiki_Constitution"
```

=== 2.3 Response Format

'''Success Response:'''
```json
{
  "query": {
    "results": {
      "BITwiki_Constitution": {
        "printouts": {
          "Has title": ["BITwiki Constitution"],
          "Has epistemic status": ["Axiomatic"],
          "Has confidence": ["1.0"]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

'''Error Response:'''
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalidtitle",
    "info": "Bad title \"Invalid|Title\"."
  }
}
```

== 3. Webhook Configuration

=== 3.1 Event Types

| Event | Trigger | Payload |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `page.created` | New page | Page title, author, timestamp |
| `page.edited` | Edit saved | Diff, author, epistemic change |
| `page.deleted` | Page removed | Title, deleter, reason |
| `epistemic.upgraded` | Status increased | Old/new status, confidence |
| `epistemic.downgraded` | Status decreased | Old/new status, reason |
| `quality.reviewed` | Audit complete | Score, issues, recommendations |

=== 3.2 Webhook Endpoint

'''Configuration:'''
```php
// LocalSettings.php
$wgBITwikiWebhooks = [
  'https://external-system.com/webhook/bitwiki' => [
    'events' => ['page.edited', 'epistemic.upgraded'],
    'secret' => 'webhook_secret_key',
    'active' => true
  ]
];
```

'''Payload Structure:'''
```json
{
  "event": "epistemic.upgraded",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-13T10:30:00Z",
  "page": {
    "title": "BITwiki_Constitution",
    "url": "https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Constitution"
  },
  "changes": {
    "old_status": "Emerging",
    "new_status": "Established",
    "old_confidence": 0.75,
    "new_confidence": 0.88
  },
  "author": {
    "username": "Hyperion",
    "id": 42
  }
}
```

=== 3.3 Signature Verification

```python
import hmac
import hashlib

def verify_webhook(payload, signature, secret):
    expected = hmac.new(
        secret.encode(),
        payload.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(f"sha256={expected}", signature)
```

=== 4.2 Import Protocol

'''Step 1: Data Validation'''
* Check required fields (title, entity type, epistemic status)
* Validate confidence range (0.0-1.0)
* Verify source provenance

'''Step 2: Epistemic Marking'''
* Imported data defaults to "Hypothetical" status
* Confidence set to 0.5 (neutral)
* Provenance tracked as import source

'''Step 3: Deduplication'''
* Check for existing entities with same title
* Merge or create new as appropriate
* Preserve both provenance chains

'''Step 4: SMW Import'''
```bash
php maintenance/importDump.php import.xml
```

== 5. Authentication

=== 5.1 OAuth 2.0 Flow

'''Step 1: Authorization Request'''
```
https://bitwiki.org/oauth/authorize?
  response_type=code&
  client_id=CLIENT_ID&
  redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI&
  scope=read+write&
  state=STATE
```

'''Step 2: Token Exchange'''
```bash
curl -X POST "https://bitwiki.org/oauth/token" \
  -d "grant_type=authorization_code" \
  -d "code=AUTH_CODE" \
  -d "client_id=CLIENT_ID" \
  -d "client_secret=CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d "redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI"
```

'''Step 3: API Access'''
```bash
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=query&..." \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN"
```

=== 5.2 API Key Management

'''Generate Key:'''

// Special:ApiKeyManager
$apiKey = hash('sha256', random_bytes(32));
```

== 6. Integration Examples

=== 6.1 Research Database Integration

'''Scenario:''' Import publications from academic database

```python
import requests

# Fetch from external API
response = requests.get('https://api.semanticscholar.org/...')
papers = response.json()

# Transform to BITwiki format
for paper in papers:
    bitwiki_page = {
        'title': paper['title'],
        'entity_type': 'Source',
        'epistemic_status': 'Established',
        'confidence': paper['citation_count'] / 1000,  # Normalized
        'has_doi': paper['doi'],
        'has_author': paper['authors']
    }
    
    # Create via BITwiki API
    requests.post(
        'https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=edit',
        data=bitwiki_page,
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN'}
    )
```

== 7. Error Handling

=== 7.1 Common Errors

| Error Code | Cause | Resolution |
|------------|-------|------------|
| `invalidtitle` | Illegal characters in title | Sanitize input |
| `missingparam` | Required parameter absent | Check API docs |
| `ratelimited` | Too many requests | Implement backoff |
| `permissiondenied` | Insufficient privileges | Check OAuth scopes |
| `epistemicviolation` | Invalid status transition | Review status rules |

=== 7.2 Retry Logic

```python
import time
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from requests.packages.urllib3.util.retry import Retry

retry_strategy = Retry(
    total=3,
    backoff_factor=1,
    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
)

session = requests.Session()
session.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy))
```

== 8. Best Practices

=== 8.1 Performance
* Cache API responses (respect Cache-Control headers)
* Use batch operations for bulk updates
* Request only needed properties
* Implement client-side rate limiting

=== 8.2 Reliability
* Handle network timeouts gracefully
* Implement exponential backoff
* Log all API interactions
* Monitor webhook delivery

=== 8.3 Security
* Never commit API keys to version control
* Rotate keys regularly
* Use minimal required scopes
* Validate webhook signatures
